name: How can cardio conditioning improve my performance in other functional fitness exercises?
description: Cardio improves recovery and muscular endurance, allowing for higher intensity and better performance in all functional fitness exercises.

mainEntity.name: How can cardio conditioning improve my performance in other functional fitness exercises?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cardio conditioning significantly improves your recovery time between sets and exercises, allowing you to maintain higher intensity throughout your entire workout. It also enhances muscular endurance, meaning your muscles can perform more repetitions or sustain effort for longer periods. This leads to overall greater strength gains and better execution of complex functional movements at Cave Training.
